operations.detail: Remote HEAD, same-owner lease, revision14 queue and absent Code-Point, consensus, hydration, exact-join, migration and acceptance outputs were revalidated.
Official OS sources confirm June 2026 GB coverage, CSV/GeoPackage supply, six-week refresh and five core UPRN coordinate fields.
ONS confirms NSUL and ONSUD GB coverage, six-week publication and CSV supply; UPRN products retain mandatory OS, Royal Mail, GeoPlace and ONS attribution.
Four packages are required: OS Open UPRN, OS LIDS UPRN-TopographicArea, NSUL and ONSUD.
Partial Range downloads resume from cache and require official byte size, OS MD5, all-package SHA-256 and ZIP integrity.
Package resolution, ArcGIS download identity, hashes, ZIP inspection, four-package count and fail-closed rules passed local preflight.
OS Open UPRN and ONS relation rows will be streamed into SQLite rather than loaded into memory.
Each ONS product must match OS Open UPRN on the identical UPRN key at or above 98 percent.
Duplicate postcode conflicts within NSUL or ONSUD and cross-product postcode conflicts must all equal zero.
Header aliases, postcode normalization, SQLite import, exact joins, conflict checks and non-promotion semantics passed local preflight.
Eighteen hydration, eighteen exact-join and ten pipeline-manifest tests passed locally; canonical runner execution remains zero.
The same attempt now targets 60 serial steps, 392 tests and 54 official source checks; no replay, new runner or global-current-task takeover occurred.
Forty pending exact UPRN-to-postcode source examples and twenty-six remote-readback artifacts are visible on the web page.
No full release package bytes, exact NSUL/ONSUD joins, UPRN examples, candidate validation or business-row write is claimed before canonical-runner recovery.
